verdict.rationale: Trilegal's own Private Equity page covers 'capital deployment' and names late-stage investors such as Prosus, with representative matters (PharmEasy, the Meesho reverse merger). Its funds page mentions venture capital, but only as fund structuring rather than company-side financing rounds. There is no dedicated venture financing practice and no evidence of seed or early priced equity rounds, so coverage is limited to later-stage, investor-side PE work. Missing for 10: a dedicated venture financing practice page, seed/Series A priced-round coverage, stated deal volume, founder/company-side representative financing transactions.
